evals.prompt: I just got a new MacBook Pro for development. Check what tools from this laptop setup skill are already installed, then show me a dry-run for installing only the missing apps. Do not install anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Runs or recommends --info and --list, then uses --install --dry-run before any mutating command. The response should summarize missing apps and avoid executing installation.

evals.prompt: Podman is installed on my Mac, but I need it to behave like Docker. Use the laptop setup skill to preview the setup steps and tell me what will touch my shell profile or require sudo.
evals.expected_output: Uses --setup --name "Podman" --dry-run, explains Podman post-install steps, calls out sudo and ~/.zshrc changes, and waits for confirmation before running setup.

evals.prompt: Can you verify whether my iOS simulators and Android emulators are available after setup?
evals.expected_output: Uses --verify, or --verify --name "Xcode" and --verify --name "Android Studio", then summarizes simulator/emulator status from the verification output.

evals.prompt: Install only my baseline laptop developer tools, but preview the commands before changing anything.
evals.expected_output: Runs or recommends --profiles if needed, then uses --list --profile baseline and --install --profile baseline --dry-run before any mutating command. The response should explain that the baseline profile is read from configs/apps.yaml and that already-installed tools are skipped.
